description: Relationship graph vectors. Check order: SELF_LINK, REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND, CROSS_REPOSITORY, then PARENT_CYCLE, DEPENDENCY_CYCLE, DUPLICATE_CYCLE on the graph after applying the task fields and relationshipEdits. add_subtask sets the child's parent; remove_subtask clears it only when it points at the edited task; add_blocked adds the edited task to the blocked task's depends_on; removals of absent links to live same-repository tasks are no-ops; explicit removal targets must be live same-repository tasks, and deleted task targets return NOT_FOUND. outcome=ok lists the stored body and every other task whose stored body changes, sorted by entity id (affected; related links are symmetric).
